CustomField.description: For Campaign Type records (Dictionary_Sub_Type__c = 'Campaign Type'): when checked, campaigns of this activation type must pick a Campaign Group from the predefined list of Campaign Group dictionary entries tied to this type. When unchecked, no Campaign Group is required (e.g. One-off).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to require campaigns of this type to choose a Campaign Group from a predefined list.
CustomField.label: Define Campaign Groups
